title: kewe darbaar gayi
body:
Kiwe Darbaar Gayi
kewe darbaar gayi berida binte ali jeri naaza dee palee
paake hathkariya jado shaam deh bazaar ayee
dadi majboor teh bechain c zahra jayi
<<DIVIDER>>
akhe sajad poophi beerh bazar bari
thoo eh naaza deh palee
hay jekoo farmaya nabi paak neh dila da tukra
hay afsoos meri sain koo haq na miliya oh jada khali walee
<<DIVIDER>>
qabar babe dee halee
chadran lutiya teh kehme v jalaye lokaa
fatima jaya koo bazaar dekhaye lokaa
shehar teh shehar phiri rul gayi ale nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
jeri naaza dee palee
veer ghazi da jadoo dhal gaya sir tho sayaa
sain zainab neh kadi sukh da na wela ayaa
kadi koofe teh kadi shaam darbaar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
hay naaza dee palee
veer sajjad dukhi behn koo chad na jawee
behn ujri noo kafan shaam da thoo na pawee
kar keh matam eh chali wich zindaan eh mari
<<DIVIDER>>
jeri nazaa dee palee
chake hatha teh sakina ko eh abid soche
kaun sunda eh meri kis noo dasawa jaa keh
chaar saala dee dukhi behn margay eh meri
<<DIVIDER>>
jeri naza dee palee.
